description: This file defines the internal partial class SiloStatusOracle within the Orleans Runtime MembershipService namespace. It manages silo statuses, maintains caches for active/silo states, and provides methods to query silo health, subscribe to status events, and manage cache updates.

classes.name: SiloStatusOracle
classes.description: Manages and queries the statuses of silos within the Orleans cluster, maintains local caches, and supports event subscriptions related to silo status changes.

methods.name: SiloStatusOracle
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and internal state.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatus
methods.description: Returns the approximate status of a specified silo.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Returns a list of addresses of currently active silos.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping silo addresses to their statuses, filtered by activity if specified.

methods.name: EnsureFreshCache
methods.description: Updates internal cache if the membership snapshot has changed.

methods.name: IsDeadSilo
methods.description: Checks if a given silo is marked as dead.

methods.name: IsFunctionalDirectory
methods.description: Determines if a silo is functioning as a directory based on status.

methods.name: TryGetSiloName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the silo name for a given address.

methods.name: SubscribeToSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Subscribes a listener to silo status change events.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes a listener from silo status change events.

methods.name: LogSiloAddressNotRegistered
methods.description: Logs a debug message when a silo address is not registered.
